title: Manager, Recruiting (London, United Kingdom)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
 As a Recruiting Manager you will cultivate, lead, mentor, grow, and hire a team of recruiting professionals supporting multiple business functions across Sales in EMEA. You will work from conception to fruition on staffing strategies to support these organizations and partner with our hiring leaders to execute top of class recruiting practices. Figma's continued future success relies heavily on the ability to scale and the talent acquisition team is at the helm of the ship.
This is a full time role that will be based in our London Hub.
 What you’ll do at Figma:
 Manage, mentor, and develop a growing team of recruiters
 Collaborate with Sales leadership to understand business needs and align recruiting resources accordingly in order to achieve goals
 Partner with recruiting leaders to develop a talent brand strategy that continues to bring in exceptional talent to Figma and showcases the incredible culture
 Create and implement a team structure that optimizes for efficiency and scale
 Champion, partner, and execute on various initiatives relating to inclusion and diversity
 Build and improve upon recruiting best practices across all orgs
 We'd love to hear from you if you have:
 10+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced, competitive environment, including 2+ years of people management experience and demonstrated expertise in SaaS sales recruiting

title: Senior Technical Solutions Specialist
description:
Role Description
 The Dropbox Sales and Channel team helps organisations transform how they work through technology. We partner with customers to understand their business challenges and develop solutions that deliver practical, measurable value.
 As a Solutions Consultant, you’ll combine technical depth with commercial judgement to help customers evaluate and adopt Dropbox products. With our work on DBX Platform, this role places particular emphasis on hands-on API experience, integrations and technical solution design.
 You’ll work directly with customer technical teams to understand their environments, design connected workflows and validate solutions through demonstrations, pilots and proofs of concept. You’ll bring experience working with APIs and scripting languages, alongside the ability to explain technical decisions and business value to stakeholders ranging from developers and IT teams to senior executives.
 Working across Direct Sales and Channel, you’ll support the full sales cycle—from discovery and technical validation through to deployment planning and handover. You’ll help shape customer solutions, influence product development through customer feedback and deepen your expertise across Dropbox’s products and platform capabilities.
 Responsibilities
 Partner with Direct Sales and Channel teams to translate customer business and technical requirements into secure, practical solutions using Dropbox products, add-ons and third-party integrations.
 Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, pilots and proofs of concept, working directly with customer technical teams to establish success criteria, test feasibility and resolve technical challenges.
 Design, build and validate API-based integrations and tailored workflows that address customer requirements and demonstrate the value of Dropbox products including DBX Platform.
 Deliver technical enablement and training to Sales Representatives, Account Managers and service delivery and channel partners.

title: Compliance Technology Program Lead
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.
 The Role
 Block is seeking a Compliance Technology Program Lead to ensure our Machine Learning and Heuristic detection models — and the data infrastructure that feeds them — are fit for purpose, for our fiat and virtual currency products. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, machine learning, and AI tooling: you will use modern intelligence tools, including Claude and other LLM-based agents, to automate significant portions of oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — turning a traditionally manual, documentation-heavy function into a scalable, defensible program. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering and BSA/AML Policy Teams to provide end-to-end technical oversight, effective challenge and ongoing monitoring throughout the model development lifecycle.
 You Will
 Build with Modern AI Tools: Use AI agents (Claude and similar LLM-based tools) to build automation that scales oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — including drafting requirements, exam-ready documentation, data quality monitoring and ongoing model performance reporting.
 Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so that automated outputs remain defensible to regulators and independent monitors.

title: Commercial Account Executive
description:

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
